# Aurum Astra

> Aurum Astra is a unisex salon and luxury spa in Hennur, Bengaluru, offering hair, skin, grooming, and massage therapy services for women and men.

Aurum Astra is located at AM Plaza, Hennur–Bagalur Main Road, Bengaluru, and is open 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily. Reservations by phone or WhatsApp at +91 91486 27266.

## Menu

- [Explore The Menu](https://connect.aurumastra.in/catalogue): Category overview of every Salon and Spa service offered, for Women, Men, and Kids.
- [Salon Services & Pricing](https://connect.aurumastra.in/salon): Full priced menu for haircuts, hair colour, hair treatments, hair spa, skin rituals, hair removal, hands & feet, makeup, bridal packages, and men's beard & grooming.
- [Spa Rituals & Massage](https://connect.aurumastra.in/spa): Full priced menu for massage and spa therapies, browsable by reason (desk & screen, pain & performance, deep rest, together, occasions) or by massage type (classic, Asian & traditional, targeted & express, couple's, wraps & hydrotherapy).
- [Spa in Hennur](https://connect.aurumastra.in/spa-in-hennur): Dedicated landing page for spa and massage services serving the Hennur, Kalyan Nagar, Kothanur, and HRBR Layout area of Bengaluru.

## Optional

- [Homepage](https://connect.aurumastra.in/): Brand overview and quick links to the menu and reservations.
